_meta.purpose: Style audit for state-of-rework briefing HTML — ensures new pages match CCv3 house style

accent.note: amber/yellow — the universal interactive accent; used for hover states, active nav borders, step numbers, stat callouts, and all clickable highlights

palette.background_gradient: radial-gradient(circle at 25% 12%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.06), transparent 55%), radial-gradient(circle at 78% 85%, rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.05), transparent 50%), var(--bg)

fonts.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

subsystem_colors.note: Sourced from architecture.json categories block — use these for subsystem-specific stripes, dots, or badges

severity_color_conventions.note: No explicit severity system exists in current viz pages (they are architecture docs). These conventions are PROPOSED for state-of-rework to match house palette tone — use consistently across all new pages.

S0_critical.label: S0 — Critical / blocking
S0_critical.usage: 3 findings; use red background badge or left-border stripe

S2_medium.label: S2 — Medium
S2_medium.usage: 108 findings; amber/yellow badge — house accent color, most numerous tier

quick_win.label: Quick Win
quick_win.usage: 12 items; green — already used for 'verdict badge' in hooks viz

structural.label: Structural Arc
structural.usage: 10 items; purple — matches agents subsystem color

leaking_seam.label: Leaking Seam
leaking_seam.usage: 6 seams; pink — matches continuity, signals cross-subsystem break

hub_structure.pattern: header + intro paragraph + responsive card grid + footer

card_anatomy.top_stripe: height:4px; width:100%; color = subsystem color (--stripe CSS var)
elements: stats bar (12px muted, accent numbers, border-top)
card_anatomy.arrow: absolute top-right; color muted; → accent on hover + translateX(2px)

deep_dive_pattern.note: Used by hooks, agents, braintrust, codex viz pages

verdict_badge.note: Used to show overall system health verdict; adapt color for mixed/warn/fail states

navigation_pattern.back_link: ← Hub in header, color var(--accent)
navigation_pattern.footer_links: Docs root + architecture.json raw + source diagrams
navigation_pattern.inter_page: Each card in hub.html links directly to its standalone page

existing_viz_files.role: Navigation hub — card grid landing page
System overview — interactive SVG flow diagram + flow steps sidebar
Hook layer deep dive — sidebar nav + section viewer
Machine-readable source of truth (nodes + flows + categories)
New directory — state-of-rework briefing pages (this slice)

reuse_notes:
For a new state-of-rework.html briefing:

1. ROOT VARS: Copy the full :root block from hub.html verbatim (--bg:#0b1020 through --shadow). Add semantic color vars from hooks-visualization.html (--green, --red, --blue, --purple, --orange, --teal) — they are not in hub.html but are needed for severity badges.

2. HEADER: Use the header.app pattern from hub.html (h1 18px 700, .sub 13px dim, .spacer flex:1, last-verified meta). Add '← Hub' anchor using hub.html style, pointing to ../hub.html.

3. BODY BACKGROUND: Use the two-radial-gradient formula from hub.html (indigo 6% at 25%/12%, amber 5% at 78%/85%). Do NOT use the ellipse variant from hooks-visualization.html — it is a different aesthetic.

4. CARD GRID: Use hub.html card grid for summary/navigation sections (minmax(280px,1fr), gap:18px). Use hooks-visualization.html stat-tile grid (grid-3 or grid-2) for findings counts and metrics.

5. CARD STYLE: Hub card style (top stripe + icon + title + desc + stats) for linking to sub-pages. Hooks-viz card style (bg-card + 12px radius + card-title uppercase) for content sections.

6. SEVERITY BADGES: Use severity_color_conventions above. S0=red, S1=orange, S2=amber (reuses --accent), S3=blue. The amber S2 badge deliberately reuses the house accent — it is the most numerous tier (108/190) and the accent color already communicates 'pay attention here'.

7. SUBSYSTEM DOT/STRIPE: When referencing a specific subsystem (hooks, agents, memory, etc.) use the subsystem_colors table for a left-border stripe or small swatch dot. This visually cross-references the existing architecture viz pages.

8. VERDICT BADGE: Adapt the hooks-viz .verdict-badge pattern. For 'mixed' verdict: use --orange (#fb923c) with orange pulsing dot. For clean subsystem: use --green. For critical: use --red.

9. FONTS: System font stack (no Google Fonts needed). Mono only for file paths and code spans — use hooks-viz .mono class pattern.

10. FOOTER: hub.html footer pattern. Links: '← Hub', 'architecture.json', 'findings.json (raw)', 'synthesis.json (raw)'. Last-verified date.
